# The Motley Fool
> Investment research, stock market news, personal finance guidance, and premium stock-picking services from The Motley Fool.

The Motley Fool publishes free market news, stock analysis, educational investing content, podcasts, and subscription research services. Its site spans breaking market coverage, company and sector analysis, market data pages, retirement and personal finance education, and premium memberships such as Stock Advisor, Epic, Epic Plus, Fool Portfolios, and Fool One.

## Core Site
- [Home](https://www.fool.com/): Main hub for stock market news, investing research, and featured recommendations.
- [All Services](https://www.fool.com/services/): Overview of Motley Fool premium investing memberships and subscription offerings.
- [Trending News](https://www.fool.com/trending-news/): Popular and timely investing stories currently drawing reader attention.
- [Live Coverage](https://www.fool.com/investing/live-coverage/): Ongoing market updates and real-time investing news coverage.
- [Stock Market News](https://www.fool.com/investing-news/): Broad market news, company updates, and investing analysis.
- [Markets](https://www.fool.com/markets/): Market index performance, movers, and daily stock market data.

## Premium Services
- [Stock Advisor](https://www.fool.com/services/stock-advisor/): Flagship stock-picking service with recommendations, rankings, and portfolio guidance.
- [Epic](https://www.fool.com/services/epic/): Premium bundle combining multiple Motley Fool research services and tools.
- [Epic Plus](https://www.fool.com/services/epic-plus/): Higher-tier membership with expanded research access and portfolio resources.
- [Fool Portfolios](https://www.fool.com/services/fool-portfolios/): Portfolio-focused service built around curated investing strategies and allocations.
- [Fool One](https://www.fool.com/services/one/): Comprehensive membership for broad access to Motley Fool premium research.
- [All Services](https://www.fool.com/services/): Compare available subscriptions, features, and investing service options.

## News and Market Coverage
- [Stock Market News](https://www.fool.com/investing-news/): Daily investing news, earnings coverage, and company-specific analysis.
- [Trending News](https://www.fool.com/trending-news/): Fast-moving stories and widely read market news articles.
- [Market Movers](https://www.fool.com/market-movers/): Coverage of stocks making notable moves during the trading day.
- [Market Trends](https://www.fool.com/market-trends/): Analysis of broader market themes, sentiment, and macro developments.
- [Tech Stock News](https://www.fool.com/tech-stock-news/): News and analysis focused on technology companies and AI-related stocks.
- [Crypto News](https://www.fool.com/crypto-news/): Cryptocurrency news, market developments, and digital asset commentary.
- [Live Coverage](https://www.fool.com/investing/live-coverage/): Rolling updates on major market events and breaking developments.

## Market Data and Movers
- [Stock Market Indexes Today](https://www.fool.com/markets/): Snapshot of major indexes, market performance, and daily trends.
- [Most Active Stocks Today](https://www.fool.com/markets/most-active-stocks/): List of heavily traded stocks with current market activity context.
- [Today's Biggest Stock Gainers](https://www.fool.com/markets/top-stock-gainers/): Daily leaderboard of top-performing stocks by price gain.
- [Market Movers](https://www.fool.com/market-movers/): Editorial coverage explaining notable stock price moves.
- [Market Trends](https://www.fool.com/market-trends/): Context for market direction, sectors, and investor sentiment shifts.
- [Live Coverage](https://www.fool.com/investing/live-coverage/): Real-time market event tracking and intraday developments.

## Investing Topics
- [Investing News](https://www.fool.com/investing-news/): General investing coverage spanning stocks, sectors, and earnings.
- [Tech Stock News](https://www.fool.com/tech-stock-news/): Technology sector reporting, company updates, and growth stock analysis.
- [Crypto News](https://www.fool.com/crypto-news/): Coverage of cryptocurrencies, blockchain developments, and related investing themes.
- [Market Trends](https://www.fool.com/market-trends/): Big-picture investing themes and market environment analysis.
- [Markets](https://www.fool.com/markets/): Data-oriented market overview with indexes and stock activity.
- [Trending News](https://www.fool.com/trending-news/): High-interest stories across major investing topics.

## Podcasts
- [All Podcasts](https://www.fool.com/podcasts/): Directory of Motley Fool podcasts covering markets and investing ideas.
- [Motley Fool Money Podcast](https://www.fool.com/podcasts/motley-fool-money/): Podcast on market news, business stories, and investing analysis.
- [Rule Breaker Investing Podcast](https://www.fool.com/podcasts/rule-breaker-investing/): Podcast focused on long-term investing, innovation, and stock-picking philosophy.

## Membership and Product Discovery
- [All Services](https://www.fool.com/services/): Starting point for evaluating Motley Fool memberships and plans.
- [Stock Advisor](https://www.fool.com/services/stock-advisor/): Entry point for Motley Fool’s best-known stock recommendation service.
- [Epic](https://www.fool.com/services/epic/): Bundle page for investors seeking broader premium research access.
- [Epic Plus](https://www.fool.com/services/epic-plus/): Advanced plan with expanded premium content and strategy access.
- [Fool Portfolios](https://www.fool.com/services/fool-portfolios/): Product page for portfolio-based investing guidance.
- [Fool One](https://www.fool.com/services/one/): Unified premium offering for extensive Motley Fool research access.

## Related Organization
- [The Motley Fool Foundation](https://foolfoundation.org/): Independent nonprofit affiliated with The Motley Fool focused on financial empowerment.
